program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Put a frog in the toilet
requirements.source_phrase: Put a frog in the toilet

outcomes.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
outcomes.target: A frog is visibly placed within the toilet bowl.
outcomes.reference: The toilet in the input image.

checks.question: Is a frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl, rather than only elsewhere on or near the toilet?
checks.complete_when: At least one recognizable frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl.
checks.partial_when: One or more frogs have been added to the toilet area, but none is clearly inside the bowl (for example, a frog is on the lid or tank).
checks.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no frog has been added to the toilet or its immediate area.
checks.unknown_when: The toilet bowl and nearby toilet surfaces cannot be assessed, or frog placement is genuinely ambiguous.
